name: EMA_WMA
summary: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy using an Exponential Moving Average (EMA) and a Weighted Moving Average (WMA). It generates buy signals when the faster EMA crosses above the slower WMA and sell signals when the EMA crosses below the WMA. The system automates trend-following entry and exit based on these crossover events.
summary_zh: 该EA使用指数移动平均线(EMA)和加权移动平均线(WMA)的双均线交叉策略。当较快的EMA上穿较慢的WMA时产生买入信号，当EMA下穿WMA时产生卖出信号。系统基于这些交叉事件自动执行趋势跟踪的入场和出场操作。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是利用EMA和WMA两条不同类型移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向并产生交易信号。入场条件为：当EMA从下方穿越WMA向上时开多单，当EMA从上方穿越WMA向下时开空单，属于典型的金叉死叉策略。出场条件通常依赖于反向交叉信号触发平仓，即持有多单时EMA下穿WMA则平多，持有空单时EMA上穿WMA则平空。仓位管理方面，该EA可能使用固定手数或基于账户资金的动态手数计算方式，但缺乏明确的仓位缩放机制。资金管理方面，策略依赖均线交叉的趋势跟踪特性，但在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。整体而言，该策略缺少止损止盈的显式设置以及过滤震荡行情的辅助条件，风险控制较为薄弱。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of this EA is to use the crossover of two different types of moving averages—EMA and WMA—to determine trend direction and generate trading signals. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the EMA crosses above the WMA from below (golden cross), and open a short position when the EMA crosses below the WMA from above (death cross), which is a classic dual MA crossover approach. Exit conditions typically rely on the reverse crossover signal to close positions—closing longs when EMA crosses below WMA and closing shorts when EMA crosses above WMA. Position sizing likely uses either a fixed lot size or a simple account-balance-based calculation, but lacks an advanced position scaling or anti-martingale mechanism. Money management relies on the trend-following nature of MA crossovers, but the strategy is vulnerable to frequent false signals and consecutive losses during ranging or choppy market conditions. Overall, the strategy lacks explicit stop-loss and take-profit settings as well as auxiliary filters for ranging markets, making its risk control relatively weak.

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
使用两种不同类型的移动平均线(EMA和WMA)，结合了指数平滑和加权平滑的优势，对价格变化的响应速度有所差异
趋势行情中能够有效捕捉中期趋势，实现顺势交易
pros_en: The strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
Uses two different types of moving averages (EMA and WMA), combining the advantages of exponential smoothing and weighted smoothing with different response speeds to price changes
Effectively captures medium-term trends in trending markets, enabling trend-following trades
cons: 均线交叉信号具有滞后性，入场往往在趋势已经走了一段之后
震荡行情中频繁产生虚假交叉信号，导致连续止损和手续费损耗
缺乏显式的止损止盈设置，完全依赖反向交叉平仓风险较大
没有行情过滤器(如ADX、波动率等)来区分趋势和震荡市场
cons_en: MA crossover signals have inherent lag, often entering after the trend has already moved significantly
Frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive stop-losses and commission drain
Lacks explicit stop-loss and take-profit settings, relying entirely on reverse crossover for exit carries significant risk
No market filter (such as ADX, volatility, etc.) to distinguish between trending and ranging conditions
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中暂停交易以减少虚假信号
添加显式的止损止盈机制和移动止损功能，改善风险管理和盈利保护
improvements_en: Add an ADX or volatility filter to pause trading during ranging markets and reduce false signals
Add explicit stop-loss/take-profit mechanisms and a trailing stop feature to improve risk management and profit protection

risk_points: 缺乏显式止损，在极端行情下可能遭受较大亏损
震荡市中频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
仓位管理较简单，未考虑账户整体风险敞口
risk_points_en: Lacks explicit stop-loss, may suffer significant losses in extreme market conditions
Frequent false signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
Position sizing is simplistic, not considering overall account risk exposure
